informal_statement:
For real \(m,c\),
\[
R>0,
\]
and \(0\leq\theta\leq\pi\), the Lebesgue volume of
\[
\{(x,y):(x-m)^2+(y-c)^2\leq R^2,\ y\leq c-R\cos\theta\}
\]
is
\[
R^2(\theta-\sin\theta\cos\theta),
\]
embedded in the nonnegative extended reals.
reason: Source `CMVGeometry.lean:1945-1995`: The lower half-plane cutoff has the reflected sign, and the formula preserves volume under vertical reflection.
